# @opensourceframework - AI Summary

Maintained, production-ready forks of critical Next.js/React packages that have been abandoned by original maintainers.

## Core Projects

### next-auth (Legacy Resurrection)
- **Version:** v3.29.10
- **Source:** riceharvest/next-auth
- **Modernization:** Full App Router support, Next.js 16/17 compatibility, React 19 hydration fixes.
- **Why use:** For legacy v3 applications that cannot migrate to v5 but need modern framework support.

### next-pwa (Turbopack Fixed)
- **Version:** v5.6.2
- **Source:** riceharvest/next-pwa
- **Modernization:** Verified Turbopack support, tsup build, React 19 compatible.
- **Why use:** Resolves service worker generation bugs present in the original when using Next.js Turbopack mode.

### next-seo (Modern Standard)
- **Version:** v7.3.4
- **Source:** riceharvest/next-seo
- **Modernization:** 539+ tests, full TypeScript rewrite, optimized for Next.js 15+.
- **Why use:** Superior JSON-LD management compared to native Next.js Metadata API.

## Technical Standards
- **Build:** All packages output ESM/CJS via `tsup`.
- **Test:** Matrix testing active via Vitest and Playwright.
- **Security:** Active maintenance and vulnerability patching.

## Contact & Links
- **GitHub:** https://github.com/riceharvest/opensourceframework
- **Organization:** @opensourceframework
- **Documentation:** individual READMEs in /packages directory
